chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

regarding a man who gave a man what he could perform Hajj with, so an event occurred with the man, he said: If he had set out and was hit (died) on part of the road, then it suffices for the first (deceased), and otherwise, no.

key_terms.الْأَوَّلِ: The first (the person who paid/ordered the Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Does an agent's death invalidate a paid Hajj if they had already started the journey?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the validity of Hajj performed by proxy (Hajj al-Badal) when the agent dies, establishing that the obligation is discharged if the agent had already commenced the journey, reflecting the Shia principle that the act's completion is tied to the agent's departure. It highlights the juristic distinction between the contractual agreement and the actual execution of the ritual, ensuring the payer’s duty is not left in limbo. This ruling underscores the practical application of 'incomplete acts' in Shia fiqh, where partial performance by the agent can suffice for the principal.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from the one who mentioned it,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who give a man what he can perform Hajj with, so an event (of death) occurs with the man. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was such that he went out and was hit in one of the roads, so it would suffice from the former (deceased), or else, so no’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “About

a man who pays another man to perform al-Hajj but something happens to him, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If he (the second man) goes for al-Hajj and something happens somewhere on the way, it is sufficient for the first one.’”
